product_definition.writer_contract: capable writer receives compact role/voice capsule only
product_definition.editor_contract: TCJ inspects exact finished copy and returns SHIP or REVISE
product_definition.revision_contract: if REVISE, same writer edits its CURRENT finished draft using one smallest useful instruction under the same role capsule

v1_role_conditioned_writer.interpretation: additional TCJ editorial brief added little over the strong simple writer role; role is not proven as sole causal factor because input shape also differed

v7.interpretation: writer simulation was poor and TCJ still falsely SHIPPED most drafts the native editor would revise; v7 cannot support selective-editor claims

tcj.next_action: Run a small fresh role-writer feasibility pilot using the simple v1-style writer role and no TCJ exposure. Human reviews only raw writer drafts for exact-copy publishability. Only if writer simulation is viable should a new fresh selective-editor bank be created. Do not reuse v7 for scoring.
